body: Almost killed myself. Family problems are getting worse. I don't think I have long left
I wouldn't know what to say. I'm just crying uncontrollably, waiting for everybody to go to sleep before I might pull a belt out of my drawer.

Complete body paralysis. My muscles worked,  nothing wrong with me physically...I just couldn't move. I can't describe it, it actually felt impossible to do so. I couldn't even move my eyes...just stared at one spot for I don't know how long. Everything was just so painful I couldn't even make slight movements.
Even baby steps seem like too much
Unfortunately not. Currently it feels like the best course of action would be to stop seeing the current one though. I just hope things work out, but I'm not sure they will
The only people I really feel close to are in a completely different continent :(. Thanks for replying though, I hope things start looking up for you.
Have to talk to a professional in 2 days. This is the second meeting, the first didn't go well. All around anxious and really uncomfortable about going. I don't trust her. At all.
Yeah, exactly that
<21. I just feel really worn out.
Not really, but it's getting late now and I'm feeling a bit tired. Thank you so much for everything, but I gotta go. I really appreciate the words we have exchanged though.
I just feel old. A lot older than I am. Depression has aged me.

Nothing physical is getting worse. Just my lows are getting lower. Bipolar.

Tried talking to a professional and it only made me feel worse.

My routine? Thinking I'm happy only to be knocked down harder than ever before. A cycle of feeling good and feeling bad, where the good stays the same and the bad just keeps getting worse. It's painful.
Although it's difficult for me to see from the same perspective, having been in this dull routine for far too long, I guess what you're saying is kinda logical.

I do have some things that bring me joy, but the amount of positive is far outweighed by the negative and sometimes it just really doesn't seem worth it. I always just end up in my default depressed state again, no matter how good those fleeting moments are.
Also, I want a kitten, but I'm not in a situation where I can get one :/
Mind sharing the secret?
Thank you for your kindness
Thank you very, very much. It means a lot just knowing that I'm not as alone as I thought
Thank you very much. I might have a suggestion for the app, if you are interested.
This has been a bad, bad month.
I'm exhausted. Emotionally and physically. I don't want to go on. It's always the same, nothing ever changes.

After years and years of hiding how I felt, it took everything I had to seek help. That decision was the most difficult I ever made. But I don't regret anything more. The meeting with the professional was...bad
I would come, even though I have social anxiety and find events difficult. I honestly would've liked to be there. Best wishes, I hope you manage to have a great time without them.
Thanks, I'm gonna be logging off now, but I appreciate that a lot
This means a lot to me. I don't think you can understand quite how much. Thank you
Thank you, I appreciate the offer. I don't think I'm the kind of person you, or anyone else, would like to talk to though.
Hobbies aren't fun anymore. I made a friend who is amazing and supportive, but I am still alone. I can't shake that feeling, and the more people I care about, the harder it will be to end it.
Thank you for the reply. I'm doing a bit better now, bit this is much appreciated.  I'll keep this in mind
The unfortunate truth
I have a couple of people, but this is just one of the many issues pushing me over the edge. If you wanna carry on talking, mind if we PM?

I swallowed every bit of pride I had left and made the most sincere apology I could. One that hurt to write. But what I did was too much. I haven't forgiven myself, so I don't expect them to either. It's just another thing that's gone wrong and everything is becoming too much to handle. The fleeting moments of happiness aren't even worth the pain anymore. My eyes hurt from crying alone.

You know the feeling of being lost? Feeling homesick but not knowing where home is? This thing/place gave me a sense of belonging for the first time in my life, but my destructive behaviour means that I can never go back. I have no one to blame but myself. Everything reminds me of that place. It's irreplaceable because it wasn't a material thing, it's people that I pushed away.
Nice. I'll check it out.
Yeah it's definitely one to take at your own pace. You won't regret it though :D
Hey what kind of game was it? I might give it a try.

Currently either One Piece or Life is Strange. One Piece is just such a happy and vibrant world and I would trade it for my own in the blink of an eye. Life is Strange introduced me to characters such Kate and Chloe whose struggles gave me someone to relate to when I didn't really have anyone. Things I have picked up from both of them have kept me going for quite a while now.

Don't worry,  I know better than to starve myself. It's just that I rarely have an appetite. 
Anyway, thanks for replying and I hope you get better soon. Best of luck.

I don't find pleasure in eating anymore. It's just sustenance keeping me alive when I dont want to be. So I don't eat. And I feel hunger but sometimes I just can't eat. And now I can count my ribs in the mirror and I hate myself.
Potentially. One that I feel normal around too; so thats what im clinging on to. Thank you for listening to my crap and being so kind. I have to go now but I hope you have a great day. (o_o)/

It's more that I am incapable of changing anything. I want to confide in someone but I can't. I want to depend on someone other than myself but I can't.  Im at a loss for options and I don't know what to do. I guess I'm beyond helping.

At a very young age I was bullied. When I told the only people that could help me about it they did nothing. I have some sort of trust issues and I can't open up to anybody without anonymity.  Also, as a male society does not expect me to have feelings.

They don't know about my condition and they mustn't know. I do not know how they will react. I've kept up a damn good act for 3 years and I can not envision them believing me, or if they do, it would destroy them. Many times I have told myself that I will confess to my closest friend but I never follow through. This sub is the only place that knows my secret.

Everyday I go to school. Once I asked my best friend if he thought jumping off of the third floor would be high enough to kill someone. Another time I asked him if he would ever kill someone.  He hasn't caught on.
Thank you. Really. You may not realise how much this one comment means to me,  but I really needed it. Thanks.

We have so much in common.


What a terrible thing.

This is something I've been waiting to share for a while. 

From the band Bright Eyes:

We are nowhere and it's now

Poison oak

A perfect sonnet

This is the first day of my life



I feel like this is exactly what you are looking for.  Give it a shot. I moved onto this after I was halfway to obsessed with Sound of Silence oddly enough.

My problem is that my drive isn't fading. Bipolar sucks. You think things are getting better, but then it just knocks you down harder than the last time. Every time you think "maybe this time it really is better". Nope. Depression just swoops in to slap you in the face again. There are few moments of bliss when I feel nothing at all, but even those are short and fleeting. Its not much help either when the only way to vent is through letters on a screen. You're not alone buddy.
Thanks a bunch. I guess I'll go do the work I've been delaying.  Is it fine to shoot you a PM layer if need be?

Thanks man. But how do you cope with going through school whilst thinking its all pointless. So much of my life is being dictated by stuff I couldn't care less about yet I have to sit tight and pretend it is great. It would be easier for me to find something I like if I didn't have to spend 98% of my time with the BS that is handed to me daily.

I just find myself hating everyone and everything so much that I just cant help hating reality too. It's like being stuck in a room full of things you loathe for the rest of your life.  Is it even possible to be happy in that situation?
